Acceptance: Acceptance rules: We accept unopened packaged goods within their labelled best-before date; fresh produce that is free of mold, rot, or pest damage; bakery items baked within the last 24 hours; and refrigerated dairy that has been kept at or below 40F (4C) continuously. We do NOT accept: home-canned or home-prepared foods, items with broken seals or damaged packaging, food past its use-by (not best-before) date, or any item that has been out of temperature control for more than 2 hours.
Window: Safe donation windows: Prepared hot meals may be donated up to 2 hours after cooking if kept hot (above 140F/60C), or up to 4 hours if promptly chilled below 40F/4C. Fresh produce should be moved within 48 hours of posting. Bakery items should be picked up within 24 hours of baking. Refrigerated dairy can be donated up to its best-before date provided the cold chain was never broken. Packaged shelf-stable goods can be donated any time before their best-before date.
Handling: Handling instructions: Keep cold items cold (at or below 40F/4C) and hot items hot (at or above 140F/60C) during transport. Use insulated containers or a refrigerated vehicle for dairy, prepared meals, and cut produce. Label every container with the item name, quantity, and pickup date. Wash hands and use clean gloves when repacking food. Never mix raw and ready-to-eat items in the same container. Record the pickup and delivery time so the cold chain can be verified.
